verdict.rationale: The evidence shows official build tooling for plugins: the `@plugin-creator` scaffolder, a documented `plugin.json`/Agent Plugins manifest schema, an app quickstart for building MCP servers with the open MCP Apps UI standard, and a Checkout API reference. None of it names an official SDK package or client library to build against, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every path. missing for 10: an explicitly named official SDK (language packages/libraries), SDK reference docs, a published API spec, and hands-on corroboration of building with an SDK.
